## Mexico City Dinner Picks for a Couple, Nov 20–23, 2026

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg

I’m assuming **Roma Norte** as the pickup point and using a **taxi travel-time cap of about 25 minutes in normal evening traffic**. Prices are estimated for **2 people before tip**, aiming to stay under **900 MXN** with a shared starter, 2 mains, and non-alcoholic drinks or a modest shared drink.

## Ranked Dinner Places by Best Overall Fit

| Rank | Place | Cuisine | Why it fits best | Est. total for 2 | Taxi from Roma Norte |
|---|---|---|---|---:|---|
| 1 | **Carmela y Sal** | Modern Mexican / Latin | Best balance of atmosphere, vegetarian options, and value; easy to make a romantic dinner without overspending | **700–900 MXN** | **10–20 min** |
| 2 | **Pasillo de Humo** | Oaxacan / Mexican | Strong regional food, several vegetable-forward dishes, and a memorable date-night feel | **650–850 MXN** | **15–25 min** |
| 3 | **Lalo!** | Modern Mexican / Latin | Casual but stylish, reliable vegetarian choices, and one of the safest budget fits | **500–800 MXN** | **10–20 min** |
| 4 | **MeroToro** | Modern Mexican / Latin | Elevated cuisine and excellent service; price can stay within budget if you order carefully | **800–900 MXN** | **20–25 min** |
| 5 | **El Cardenal** | Traditional Mexican | Classic Mexico City dinner with vegetarian-friendly staples and strong value | **450–750 MXN** | **10–20 min** |

### 1) Carmela y Sal
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg

- **Best overall fit** for a couple wanting a polished dinner that still feels approachable.
- Good match for **Mexican/Latin flavors**, with enough vegetarian options to build a full meal.
- Budget is usually manageable if you skip cocktails and focus on shared plates.

### 2) Pasillo de Humo
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/signpost-split.svg

- Excellent if you want a **regional Mexican dinner** with more personality than a standard cantina.
- Vegetarian-friendly choices are available, especially around **moles, vegetables, beans, and sides**.
- Slightly more destination-worthy than casual spots, while still staying near budget.

### 3) Lalo!
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/shop.svg

- Strong value pick for a **modern Latin/Mexican** dinner that won’t feel heavy on the wallet.
- Works well if you want a **lively but not formal** date-night setting.
- The easiest option here to keep **comfortably under 900 MXN**.

### 4) MeroToro
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/star.svg

- Best if you want the **most refined meal** on the list.
- It can still fit the budget, but only with **disciplined ordering**.
- Choose this if atmosphere and culinary polish matter more than maximizing portion size.

### 5) El Cardenal
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg

- Very solid for a **classic Mexico City dinner** with dependable quality.
- Usually the **best value** of the group, especially for vegetarian-friendly traditional dishes.
- Less “special occasion” than the top 3, but excellent if you want reliable, local flavor.
